question: Does an independent confirmation gate improve a discovered subgroup correction beyond independent estimation and validation-selected shrinkage under a fixed available labeling budget?
status: Protocol fixed before the new study's evaluation runs; source benchmark was previously inspected; external benchmark is frozen evaluation only; not an independently registered preregistration

auditor.estimation_matching: Select k represented tasks from D and E using outcome-independent seeded permutations, where k is their smaller represented-task count; retain qualifying rows from those tasks
auditor.shared_eligibility: k >= 8 and at least 8 represented C tasks; applied to all four factorial arms and both D-rule shrinkage controls
auditor.gate: C task-cluster percentile-bootstrap residual interval excludes zero and its sign agrees with the full-D discovery residual
auditor.selection: Shrinkage minimizes validation Brier; grid order favors smaller steps on exact ties
auditor.membership: All corrections use the single frozen rule and its original pre-correction score band

budget_rounding: Floor discovery, estimation and confirmation counts; assign remainder to validation; nested prefixes within maximum-budget role pools

source.calibration: All eight experimental methods start from the same fold-specific Platt scores; raw logistic is an additional predictive reference
source.group_thresholds: Training-feature 75th percentiles; same fixed group family as the original reference
source.scope: Task-separated exploratory development on the already-inspected LiveCodeBench archive

simulation.features: Sixteen standard-normal marginal coordinates; a task component plus candidate noise of scale 0.25, normalized by sqrt(1.0625)
simulation.truth: clip(p - effect * I[X1 > norm.isf(sqrt(prevalence)) and X2 > norm.isf(sqrt(prevalence))], 0, 1)
simulation.labels: Independent candidate Uniform draws or one shared Uniform per task, each preserving the specified marginal success probability
simulation.primary_metric: MSE against known probability on independent simulated test tasks
simulation.signal_reference: Selected-rule mean known-probability residual on the independent finite test pool; magnitude > epsilon; a Monte Carlo reference, not an exact population classification
simulation.null_rate_interval: 95% Clopper-Pearson binomial interval across 100 independent fitting seeds per setting
simulation.contrast_interval: Paired bootstrap of complete fitting-seed replicates; 2000 draws; no simultaneous-coverage claim

external.purpose: Frozen evaluation only; no external fitting, calibration, hyperparameter selection or outcome-dependent filtering
external.publication: Aggregate evaluation results and source/provenance hashes only; per-row features, labels, prompts, programs and token records stay in the ignored local cache
external.overlap_check: Report exact normalized-prompt hash overlap if original source prompts are locally available; identity namespaces and prompt hashes do not rule out semantic overlap or model-training contamination
external.aggregation: Average frozen source-fold predictions per answer at the primary source budget, then evaluate once across the 161 external task clusters; no selection among source folds using external outcomes

interpretation: This isolates one proposed correction, not full iterative multicalibration
Gate contrasts share the identical selected rule, estimates, step and membership-only support eligibility
The D-versus-E estimator comparison matches represented-task counts, but qualifying candidate counts and selection dependence can still differ
The factorial leaves some available labels unused; the pooled validation-tuned comparator tests practical use of the same available budget
Record fitting/selection label queries separately from diagnostic label reads and total available labels
Source-fold contrasts are descriptive conditional on overlapping fits, not independent replications
New synthetic fitting seeds are independent replications within a setting; settings share seeds and do not imply simultaneous coverage
Bootstrap confirmation is approximate and has no exact error-control guarantee
External scores and corrections are frozen before external outcome evaluation; the external benchmark cannot be used as ML training data
Implementation and analysis are AI-assisted; no novelty, elapsed project duration or historical deployment claim is established by this protocol
